sg-2-0-4-3.title: The Open Cedar Gate
sg-2-0-4-3.text:
Weathered cedar panels swing wide between carved stone pillars, inviting weary travelers into the outer courtyard of the well-station. Copper wind-chimes suspended from the eaves tinkle softly in the dry breeze, offering a melodic contrast to the unrelenting glare of the salt flats.

Dust settles around your boots as you weigh the various paths stretching out before you under the blinding noon sky.
exits: Turn back toward the distant ridge

sg-2-0-4-4.title: The Timber Lever Pump
sg-2-0-4-4.text:
Narrow gaps between towering stacks of empty water-barrels open directly into a sunlit square dominated by a heavy timber lever pointing skyward. The air smells sharply of damp earth and rusted iron where previous travelers have drawn their daily share from the hidden aquifers below.

Dust motes dance in the harsh light as you stand considering which direction to take next.
exits: Follow the path toward the inner courtyard

sg-2-0-4-5.title: The Stone Entrance Post
sg-2-0-4-5.text:
Pale linen rustles softly as a solemn guard nods from her post beside the arched stone entrance, her fingers resting lightly on a notched wooden tally-staff. She watches your approach with quiet vigilance, marking every traveler who crosses the threshold into the well-station compound.

The cool shadow of the stone archway offers a brief reprieve from the desert heat.
exits: Divert toward the barrel storage yard

sg-2-0-4-6.title: The Seepage Puddle
sg-2-0-4-6.text: Desert pigeons scatter into the dazzling sky as you draw near a circular stone reservoir, their wings beating a frantic rhythm against the dry heat. A handful of thirsty birds have been drinking greedily from a damp seepage puddle clinging to the masonry's mossy flank. Your canvas water-skin feels light and warm at your hip, and the cool smell of mud offers a sharp temptation in the glaring white expanse. You must decide whether to linger here and try to gather a few precious drops from the stones or leave the birds in peace and continue across the blazing flats.
exits: Approach the stone rim to gather the seepage
Leave the reservoir behind and press onward

sg-2-0-4-7.title: The Red Clay Plaza
sg-2-0-4-7.text:
Crushing white salt crust gives way beneath your boots to packed red clay as you step onto the sacred plaza of the well-station, bringing your grueling march across the flats to a close. Ornate mosaics set into the brickwork depict legendary rains of the past.

The atmosphere shifts perceptibly as you stand at the center of the spacious courtyard.

sg-2-0-5-0.title: The Bronze Measuring Cup
sg-2-0-5-0.text:
Severe lines mark the face of the matriarch standing before the main well-head, holding out a heavy bronze measuring cup as a token of the station's liquid wealth. She demands your formal, unyielding agreement to an unbreakable oath before a single drop passes your parched lips.

The surrounding guards watch your hands for any sign of hesitation.
exits: Press on and make your choice

sg-2-0-5-1.title: The Striped Canvas Pavilion
sg-2-0-5-1.text:
Colored canvas flutters above the central pavilion where the chief well-keeper extends a clay beaker filled with cool, sweet water. She warns you plainly that partaking of this vital resource requires binding yourself to fulfill one future request without question or hesitation.

Sunlight filters through the fabric overhead, casting striped shadows across the dusty ground.
exits: Press on and make your choice

sg-2-0-5-2.title: The Guarded Trough
sg-2-0-5-2.text: A cloaked sister steps out beside the creaking wooden pump, blocking your direct approach to the stone water trough with calm finality. She lays out the sacred binding terms required of every traveler, her voice dry as the salt crystals dusting her hem. To taste the station's deep reserve, you must swear an unbreakable oath to the well-keepers, tying your future steps to their hidden designs. You weigh the heavy thirst scratching at your throat against the dangerous price of a stranger's binding word.
exits: Swear the binding oath to drink deeply
Refuse the terms and walk away from the pump

sg-2-0-5-3.title: The Silver Bowl
sg-2-0-5-3.text: Cool shade pours from the open door of the stone cistern house, offering a brief reprieve from the blinding glare of the Bitterflats. The keeper of the well stands within, holding out a silver-rimmed bowl of water that glints with unbearable invitation. She asks if you are willing to pledge your solemn word to answer a future summons in return for this life-saving hydration. Your fingers tighten around the cold ceramic Seedkey in your pocket while you weigh the cost of indebted freedom.
exits: Accept the bowl and make the solemn pledge
Decline the offer and turn back to the salt

sg-2-c1.title: The Binding Oath
sg-2-c1.text:
Steam rises faintly from the stone well-mouth as the well-keepers gather close, waiting for your final word on the bargain. Accepting their water means pledging your future loyalty to an unknown demand, whereas refusing leaves you to carry your thirst back out into the blinding white expanse with your own dwindling supplies.

The choice hangs heavy in the dry air between you and the silent watchers.
exits: Swear the well-oath for water and shelter
Refuse the oath and pay dear for water
